Shearform Pty. Ltd. is a steel solutions company that strives to keep all processing in house, with a continuous improvement policy that allows us to invest in the latest technology, machinery, handling equipment and increasing our capacities to allow us to handle all types of work from small to large offering the most economical steel solutions in Melbourne to the Australian Industry.

We are seeking an experienced and qualified ENGINEERING TECHNOLOGIST to join and bring their expertise to our dedicated professional team in Dandenong South Victoria.

The Role
In this role, you will be responsible for applying engineering technology principles to Quality Assurance and Quality Control (QA/QC) activities across Shearform’s operations and report to the Quality Manager/ Operations Manager

Your Duties and Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
Apply established engineering technologies and principles to support quality assurance and quality control systems
Review and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and standards
Collaborate with engineers and other Professionals to develop and implement engineering solutions
Prepare, implement, and maintain Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) and quality documentation
Conduct inspections, testing, and verification of engineering materials, components, and systems
Ensure compliance with Australian Standards (AS) and relevant international standards (ISO, ASTM, ASME)
Identify, analyse, and manage non-conformances (NCRs) and implement corrective actions
Perform root cause analysis using engineering methodologies
Liaise with engineers, technicians, and operational teams to resolve technical issues
Support operational activities and supervise technical staff to ensure engineering compliance
Conduct inspections to ensure engineering technologies are applied in compliance with relevant regulations and standards
Prepare technical reports, inspection records, and compliance documentation

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Bachelor’s or associate degree in engineering technology, or a related field
More than 2 years of relevant work experience
Strong skills in data analysis, and technical reporting
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
Hands-on experience with troubleshooting, repairing, and operating machinery
Ability to apply engineering mathematics and physics to solve practical problems
Excellent communication skills. Ability to work in teams, liaising between engineers, contractors, and, production staff

If you have the skills required for this role and you feel this is the job for you, then apply now!
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super

 Proven experience supervising ceiling and partition packages on commercial or high-rise construction projects

 Competitive salary package of $180,000 - $200,000 + Super
